description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateHistory entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_job_candidate_history' and includes properties for candidate history records with relationships to Candidate, Vacancy, Interview, and Employee entities. It provides getter and setter methods for each property and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: CandidateHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing a candidate's history record in the recruitment process, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_job_candidate_history'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the candidate history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the candidate history record.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate entity associated with this history record.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with this history record.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the Vacancy entity related to this history record, if any.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Sets the Vacancy entity related to this history record.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the vacancy associated with the candidate at the time of this history record.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Sets the name of the vacancy associated with the candidate.

methods.name: getInterview
methods.description: Returns the Interview entity linked to this history record.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity with this history record.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action code representing what operation was performed.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action code.

methods.name: getPerformedBy
methods.description: Returns the Employee who performed the action.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Sets the Employee who performed the action.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the action was performed.

methods.name: setPerformedDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time when the action was performed.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any note associated with this history record.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for this history record.

methods.name: getInterviewers
methods.description: Returns the interviewers involved, deprecated.

methods.name: setInterviewers
methods.description: Sets the interviewers involved, deprecated.
